Meta.title: The Iraqi Curator — The Art Class We Didn't Take At School
Meta.description: A Baghdad-born, bilingual archive of Iraqi art, essays, workshops and exhibitions. No grades, no uniforms.

Hero.alt: درس الفنية اللي ما اخذناه بالمدرسة
Hero.intro: A bilingual archive, classroom and noticeboard for contemporary Iraqi art — exhibitions, workshops, essays and the artists your textbook skipped.

Sections.timetable_sub: Exhibitions, workshops and talks. Attendance optional, curiosity mandatory.
Sections.curriculum_sub: Four subjects. Pick any. There is no exam.
Sections.quiz_sub: Close your books. Six questions on the art history you were never taught.
Sections.seal_sub: Five thousand years ago you'd sign with a cylinder seal. Type your name, roll it in clay, keep the impression.
Sections.feed_sub: Short lessons from the Instagram classroom.
Sections.enroll_sub: Want to show work, run a workshop, collaborate or just say hi? Pass a note.

Footer.about: The Iraqi Curator is a bilingual, Baghdad-made initiative documenting contemporary Iraqi art, culture and thought — through exhibitions, workshops, essays and a digital museum.

Manifesto.title: Manifesto
Manifesto.sub: House rules for a classroom with no walls. Read them out loud.
Manifesto.colophon_body: Set in Instrument Serif, Space Grotesk, Space Mono, Lalezar and IBM Plex Sans Arabic, with a little Noto Sans Cuneiform for the seals. Photocopied, taped and built in Baghdad.
